privileged_info_for_vlm: The target location is Ames, Iowa (42.03, -93.62). Turbine counts for ~10MW: V90-2.0 (5 turbines), GE 1.6-100 (6 turbines = 9.6MW or 7 turbines = 11.2MW; 6 is closer to 10MW), V110-2.0 (5 turbines). The V110-2.0MW typically yields the highest capacity factor and lowest LCOE due to the larger rotor and higher hub height (95m) compared to the others in this specific wind regime.
